author: Leila Gharani
description:
There are three types of people who complicate Excel. None of them know they're doing it.

⚡ Black Friday: every XelPlus course is 50% off until Dec 1. If this video made you want to go back to the basics, Excel Essentials is a good place to start 👉 https://www.xelplus.com/course/black-friday/

For the full set, the Complete Excel & AI Kit includes 12 courses.

The three types are the dragger, the over-engineer and the hostage. I was the over-engineer for years, so some of this is a confession. You'll see why OFFSET slows your workbook down, what TAKE and FILTER do instead, and why Copilot can make you a hostage again if you don't check the formulas it writes. I also cover Abraham Luchins' 1942 water jar puzzle and the Einstellung effect, which explains why we keep using the method we learned first.

✅ Good to know
✅ OFFSET is a volatile function. It recalculates every time Excel recalculates, not only when its inputs change.
✅ TAKE needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024. FILTER works in E
title: The Most Dangerous Excel User (Do You Qualify?)
